title.en: What it's like to be on a warship like the USS Abraham Lincoln
title.zh: 乘坐亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰这样的军舰是什么感觉

summary.en: Concerns have mounted about conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been deployed since 11 December.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US Navy veteran Jonny Burnell spent 111 days aboard the battleship USS Vinson during the US war with Afghanistan in 2001.

His role as a Navy photographer allowed him to visit crew throughout the ship, unlike most sailors who are confined to parts of the vessel where they work. In an age before digital photography, troops were often eager to get their picture snapped whenever they saw him.

Over more than three months aboard the USS Carl Vinson, he witnessed a change among the crew as their excitement and energy faded to what he called a "sadness".

"There was one point where there was a visible kind of deadness in the shipmates' eyes", he recalls. "I still think the hardest part of my job was watching the sadness in people's faces every frickin' day."

Burnell told the BBC he's been watching on the brink of tears as concern mounts about conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln - which has been deployed as part of the US-Iran war since 11 December, more than double his deployment aboard the Vinson.

Military on the Lincoln are reportedly contending with food shortages, broken plumbing and exhaustion, according to two US publications that cover the military - the Military Times and Stars & Stripes.

Family members of sailors onboard have expressed concern about their mental health deteriorating due to the conditions, with some sailors having reportedly attempted to jump overboard.

Military officials have disputed that there are severe issues afflicting the ship, and some veterans have also suggested that the accounts in the media are overblown.

The reports in the media are largely inaccurate, and "99% hype," says retired Navy Lt Commander Steve Rogers, Director of the Association of the United States Navy (AUSN).

As part of his job for the AUSN - a non-profit that works to help US Navy servicemembers - he has been speaking to relatives of troops on the Lincoln. He says its normal for families to worry about their loved ones at war, and that the troops are well prepared for the situation they find themselves in.

In an interview with the BBC, a relative of one sailor on the Lincoln said that their family member had lost 65lbs (29kg), and has been suffering from exhaustion because of the constant noise and vibrations.

Asked about the situation aboard the Lincoln on Friday, Trump dismissed the reports, saying the deployment is "not nearly long enough". On Sunday, the head of US Central Command, which oversees operations in the Middle East, released a statement saying that of the 11 active aircraft carriers in the US military "the Lincoln currently has among the lowest number of cases related to mental health".

"This doesn't mean all is perfect," said Admiral Brad Cooper, adding that "service at sea for long periods isn't for everyone".

title.en: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
title.zh: 德国瞄准小船团伙时在秘密警察仓库内

summary.en: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Germany has carried out its first raids under a new law to crack down on smugglers using the country as a staging post for small boat crossings on the English Channel, the BBC has learned.

More than 9,000 life jackets, dozens of dinghies and engines and 360 pumps were seized by police this spring during a joint operation involving the UK, France and Germany in the North Rhine-Westphalia region.

The dinghies and equipment are now being stored at a secret location that the BBC was given special access to.

The boats could have taken more than 2,000 migrants across the Channel illegally, according to the UK's National Crime Agency.

Gangs have long used garages or warehouses to store equipment in western Germany before transporting it to northern France, but Berlin passed a law last December making it a specific criminal offence to facilitate migrant smuggling to the UK.

Before that, key anti-smuggling laws in Germany only applied to nations within the EU's zone of free movement, not to third countries, which included the UK post-Brexit.

Raids have happened in Germany before, but often relied on French or Belgian warrants.

In 2024, Germany said it would tighten its laws to make it easier to prosecute those helping to ferry migrants to the UK, as part of a new plan agreed between the two countries.

It followed a BBC investigation which exposed the country's role in the small boat supply chain .

Germany's Interior Ministry confirmed that these raids marked the first time enforcement measures had been taken under the new law, but did not confirm if the law had been employed more than once.

The BBC was able to see the results at an undisclosed police storehouse in western Germany. The stash has been kept much as it was found. The dinghies, that officials say measure approximately 9m (29ft), are deflated and mainly packaged up in cardboard boxes.

In June, when the National Crime Agency first revealed the raids had happened, it was estimated that the equipment could have taken more than 2,000 people across the Channel - which would work out to about 65 people per dinghy.

That number is less than the so-called mega dinghies seen this summer but matches recent averages as well as the general trend of rising passenger numbers.

Oxford's Migration Observatory , external believes the emergence of these mega dinghies is likely connected to increased enforcement, as there is an "additional incentive for smugglers to fit as many people as possible into available boats".

Gangs are prone to adapt - rather than abandon - their money-making schemes when supply lines are disrupted.

title.en: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
title.zh: IVF工作人员被指控在塞浦路斯北部的精子和卵子捐赠者方面误导英国父母

summary.en: Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using sperm and egg donors which were not the ones selected by the parents.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
At least 30 children, most of them British, are feared to have been conceived by IVF treatment in northern Cyprus using the wrong sperm or egg donors.

In each case, the parents suspect they did not get the donors they had selected.

The figure is one of several new findings in a BBC investigation that, earlier this year , uncovered the first seven cases.

All the parents say they carefully selected anonymous donors based on information such as their medical history, appearance, personality, education and hobbies.

However, they have concerns the requested sperm and egg donors may not have been used in their fertility treatments.

Half of the 30 children were born from procedures at one clinic, Dogus IVF Centre.

"It's absolutely scandalous," said one of the mothers, Rachel, who recently learned that she received the wrong sperm donor from the clinic.

Three people - Dr Firdevs Uguz Tip, Dr Sevket Alpturk, and a patient co-ordinator Julie Hodson - were involved in the care of many of these patients at Dogus.

Parents suspect these members of staff may have misled them. Firdevs denies any wrongdoing and neither Alpturk or Hodson have responded to our questions.

The BBC has also now learnt that the world's largest sperm bank, Cryos International, has blacklisted Dogus clinic since 2016.

Have you been affected by the issues raised in this story? Contact the BBC at: fertilityinvestigation@bbc.co.uk

In northern Cyprus - a territory where European Union laws do not apply and which is only legally recognised by Turkey - clinics are loosely regulated and promise patients low prices, high success rates and a wide choice of sperm and egg donors.

It is one of the most popular destinations for British people seeking fertility treatment abroad.

We first revealed the emerging scandal in March where a small group of parents appeared to have been misled about donors.

Responding to the allegations, the territory's Ministry of Health said it had launched an official investigation. However, it has not responded to our repeated requests for more information.

Since then, more parents have contacted us and their stories have concerning similarities.

The majority said the clinics they had used had promised them screened, healthy donors from Western Europe, but that they had become suspicious after their children were born.

Eleven of the 30 children have now taken commercial DNA tests which show they have inherited genetic ancestry from Turkey or surrounding countries.

The majority of the children who have done DNA tests were conceived through IVF between 2012 and 2024 at Dogus clinic.

Families have been left with questions about who their children's real donors are and their medical histories.

body.zh: 恐怕至少有 30 名儿童（其中大多数是英国人）在塞浦路斯北部通过体外受精治疗使用了错误的精子或卵子捐赠者而受孕。 在每一个案例中，父母都怀疑他们没有得到他们选择的捐赠者。 这个数字是英国广播公司今年早些时候调查的几项新发现之一，该调查发现了前七起案件。 所有的家长都表示，他们根据病史、外貌、性格、教育程度和爱好等信息，精心挑选了匿名捐赠者。 然而，他们担心所要求的精子和卵子捐赠者可能没有用于他们的生育治疗。 30 名儿童中有一半是在 Dogus IVF 中心一家诊所进行的手术中出生的。 “这绝对是可耻的，”其中一位母亲雷切尔说，她最近得知自己从诊所接受了错误的精子捐赠者。 三人——Firdevs Uguz Tip 医生、Sevket Alpturk 医生和患者协调员 Julie Hodson——参与了多格斯医院许多患者的护理工作。 家长怀疑这些工作人员可能误导了他们。菲尔德夫斯否认有任何不当行为，阿尔普图克和霍德森都没有回应我们的问题。 BBC 现在还获悉，全球最大的精子库 Cryos International 自 2016 年以来已将 Dogus 诊所列入黑名单。 您是否受到这个故事中提出的问题的影响？联系 BBC：fertilityinvestigation@bbc.co.uk 在塞浦路斯北部——欧盟法律不适用、只有土耳其在法律上承认的地区——诊所监管宽松，并向患者承诺低廉的价格、高成功率以及广泛的精子和卵子捐赠者选择。 它是英国人在国外寻求生育治疗的最受欢迎的目的地之一。 我们在三月份首次披露了这一新出现的丑闻，其中一小群家长似乎在捐赠者问题上受到了误导。 针对这些指控，该地区卫生部表示已展开正式调查。然而，它没有回应我们一再要求提供更多信息的要求。 从那时起，越来越多的家长联系我们，他们的故事有很多相似之处。 大多数人表示，他们使用的诊所曾向他们承诺筛选来自西欧的健康捐赠者，但他们在孩子出生后开始怀疑。 30 名儿童中有 11 名现已接受商业 DNA 测试，结果显示他们继承了土耳其或周边国家的遗传血统。 大多数接受 DNA 检测的孩子都是 2012 年至 2024 年间在 Dogus 诊所通过体外受精受孕的。 人们对孩子的真正捐赠者是谁以及他们的病史留下了疑问。 “这些报告令人深感不安，”创始人劳拉·布里金斯 (Laura Bridgens) 说。

title.en: Russia warns UK over supplying drones to Ukraine
title.zh: 俄罗斯就英国向乌克兰提供无人机发出警告

summary.en: Russia has issued a warning to the UK regarding its supply of drones to Ukraine. In response, a UK Ministry of Defence spokesperson stated that Britain stands "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯就英国向乌克兰提供无人机一事向英国发出警告。英国国防部发言人回应称，英国与乌克兰“并肩作战”。

body.en:
Russia has accused the UK of "deliberately opting for an escalation of the Ukraine crisis" following confirmation that British-made drones had been used in strikes on targets in Russia.

"In doing so, the United Kingdom is acting as an accomplice and co-perpetrator of the bloody crimes and terrorist attacks," the Russian Embassy to the UK wrote in a statement.

"London's actions will inevitably carry consequences for which it will have to answer," it said, adding that the deeper its involvement in the conflict, "the higher the price it will pay".

In response, a spokesperson for the Ministry of Defence (MoD) told BBC News that Britain stood "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.

"Russia should be in no doubt about the resolve of this Government to stand against Russian aggression, in Ukraine and against the UK and our allies," said the spokesperson in a statement.

The UK, they added, was "committed to providing the equipment Ukraine needs to defend itself against [Russian President Vladimir] Putin's illegal invasion".

Built by two separate British companies, the drones in question have been used inside Russia in widespread and successful targeting of military and industrial targets, including refineries and warehouses of the online retailer Wildberries.

Ukraine has repeatedly targeted the company, known as Russia's version of Amazon, and says that seven out of 10 of the largest Wildberries logistics centres have been "disabled".

A military source confirmed to the BBC that UK drones had been used in the attacks, which are said to have caused more than £35bn in economic damage.

Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and currently controls approximately a fifth of Ukrainian territory.

Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova has said drones using UK components and configurations were used to attack Russian territory, including a fuel depot in the Kamensky District of the Rostov Region.

In the latest attacks overnight, Russian officials said some 620 drones had been flown towards the region surrounding Moscow. Russian air defences destroyed more than 180 of the drones but several people were left wounded, the officials said.

An attack the night before saw nine people killed and 23 injured, including a child.

On Saturday night, Ukraine fired some 822 drones towards Russia, with 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor, who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". Seven deaths were reported across Russia.

On the same night, Russian attacks on Ukraine killed at least seven people and injured more than 39.

body.zh: 在确认英国制造的无人机被用于袭击俄罗斯目标后，俄罗斯指责英国“故意选择升级乌克兰危机”。 俄罗斯驻英国大使馆在一份声明中写道：“英国这样做，是血腥犯罪和恐怖袭击的共犯和共犯。” 声明称，“伦敦的行动将不可避免地带来后果，必须对此做出回应”，并补充说，其卷入冲突越深，“付出的代价就越高”。 作为回应，英国国防部发言人告诉英国广播公司新闻，英国与乌克兰“肩并肩”。 这位发言人在一份声明中表示：“俄罗斯应该毫不怀疑本届政府反对俄罗斯在乌克兰的侵略、反对英国和我们的盟友的决心。” 他们补充说，英国“致力于提供乌克兰所需的设备，以抵御俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的非法入侵”。 这些无人机由两家独立的英国公司制造，已在俄罗斯境内广泛成功地用于瞄准军事和工业目标，包括在线零售商 Wildberry 的炼油厂和仓库。 乌克兰多次针对这家被称为俄罗斯版亚马逊的公司，并表示最大的 Wildberry 物流中心中有十分之七已“瘫痪”。 一名军方消息人士向 BBC 证实，此次袭击使用了英国无人机，据称造成了超过 350 亿英镑的经济损失。 俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，目前控制着乌克兰约五分之一的领土。 俄罗斯外交部发言人玛丽亚·扎哈罗娃表示，使用英国部件和配置的无人机被用来攻击俄罗斯领土，包括罗斯托夫地区卡缅斯基区的一个燃料库。 莫斯科向英国发出警告之前，乌克兰对俄罗斯发动了一波袭击，最近一次袭击发生在周一，造成 9 人死亡、23 人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。 乌克兰州长表示，周六晚上，乌克兰向俄罗斯发射了约 822 架无人机，其中 600 架瞄准莫斯科，俄罗斯首都遭受了“近期记忆中最大规模的无人机袭击之一”。俄罗斯各地报告有七人死亡。 当晚，俄罗斯对乌克兰发动袭击，造成至少7人死亡、超过39人受伤。 今年四月，国防部宣布将向乌克兰供应数万架无人机，其中包括远程打击装置，这是有史以来规模最大的一揽子计划。

title.en: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
title.zh: 图帕克谋杀案审判：目击者称说唱歌手枪击之夜“地狱般混乱”

summary.en: An officer testified in court that after being shot multiple times, rapper Tupac Shakur declined to cooperate with police, reportedly telling an officer, "We'll take care of it."
summary.zh: 一名警官在法庭上作证说，说唱歌手图帕克·沙库尔在多次中枪后拒绝与警方合作，并告诉一名警官：“我们会处理的。”

body.en:
In the opening day of Tupac Shakur's murder trial, prosecutors painted former gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis as someone seeking revenge before masterminding the drive-by shooting that killed the iconic rapper.

Witnesses took a Las Vegas jury back in time three decades ago to the night Shakur was shot, when gangs had a hold over '90s hip-hop and distrust in police led to a lack of cooperation - and one of the most famous cold cases of the last century.

Prosecutors allege that although Davis did not fire the gun that killed the influential rapper, he allegedly orchestrated the killing. Davis has denied the allegations and pleaded not guilty.

In opening arguments, the prosecution portrayed Davis as the ringleader of the group responsible for the shooting - and point to a memoir he co-authored where he wrote in detail about the night of the shooting.

"Let's be clear, Duane Davis did not pull the trigger. But he did plan the shooting in retaliation of the beating of his nephew," Chief Deputy District Attorney Binu Palal told the jury. "Remarkably, you will learn that from Duane Davis himself."

Davis' attorneys called the narrative "fiction", dubbing the case a product of a flawed-decades-long investigation. Davis has distanced himself from the memoir, saying he didn't write all of it and parts were fictionalised to sell more copies.

Davis, wearing a navy suit and blue tie, sat with his defence team as they questioned why no one had been arrested for nearly three decades and asked why "no one corroborates any of this".

"What facts do they have after 30 years?" his attorney Michael Sanft questioned.

The prosecution's first witness was Garry Dale, who was working for the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department at the time of the shooting in September 1996.

The officer detailed riding in an ambulance with Shakur after he'd been shot. He said the rapper refused to offer any information on what happened and who had shot him. "We'll take care of it," Shakur said, according to the officer's testimony.

At the core of the case is East Coast vs West Coast rap rivalries and turf wars between the Bloods and the Crips street gangs that were immortalised in rap lyrics and news reports in the 1990s.

Police have long said said a lack of cooperation in the case led to dead ends in their investigation. Members of the rapper's entourage, though, have accused authorities of initially treating them like suspects and failing to follow important leads.

Throughout the day on Monday, prosecutors painted that picture for the jury, explaining that there were no formal criminal charges in the shooting because in the world of guns and gangs "silence means survival".

body.zh: 在图帕克·沙库尔谋杀案审判的第一天，检察官将前帮派头目杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯描绘成一个在策划杀害这位标志性说唱歌手的驾车枪击事件之前寻求复仇的人。 目击者将拉斯维加斯陪审团带回了三十年前，Shakur 被枪杀的那晚，当时黑帮盛行 90 年代的嘻哈音乐，对警察的不信任导致缺乏合作，这也是上世纪最著名的悬案之一。 检察官称，虽然戴维斯没有开枪杀死这位有影响力的说唱歌手，但据称他策划了这起谋杀。戴维斯否认了这些指控并表示不认罪。 在开庭陈词中，检方将戴维斯描述为负责枪击事件的团伙头目，并指出他与人合着的一本回忆录，其中详细描述了枪击当晚的情况。 “我们要明确的是，杜安·戴维斯没有扣动扳机。但他确实策划了枪击事件，以报复他的侄子被殴打，”首席副检察官比努·帕拉尔告诉陪审团。 “值得注意的是，你将从杜安·戴维斯本人那里学到这一点。” 戴维斯的律师称这种叙述是“虚构的”，并称此案是长达数十年的有缺陷的调查的产物。戴维斯与这本回忆录保持了距离，称这本书并非全部都是他写的，部分内容是虚构的，目的是为了卖更多的销量。 戴维斯身穿海军西装，打着蓝色领带，与他的辩护团队坐在一起，他们质疑为什么近三十年来没有人被捕，并询问为什么“没有人证实这一点”。 “30年后他们掌握了什么事实？”他的律师迈克尔·桑夫特问道。 检方的第一位证人是加里·戴尔（Garry Dale），1996 年 9 月枪击事件发生时，他正在拉斯维加斯大都会警察局工作。 这名警官详细描述了沙库尔中枪后与他一起乘坐救护车的情况。他说说唱歌手拒绝提供有关发生的事情以及谁开枪打死他的任何信息。根据该警官的证词，沙库尔说：“我们会处理这件事。” 此案的核心是东海岸与西海岸的说唱竞争以及 Bloods 和 Crips 街头帮派之间的地盘争夺战，这些在 20 世纪 90 年代的说唱歌词和新闻报道中永垂不朽。 警方长期以来一直表示，案件中缺乏合作导致调查陷入僵局。不过，这位说唱歌手的随行人员指责当局最初将他们视为嫌疑人，并且未能追踪重要线索。 周一一整天，检察官向陪审团描述了这一情况，解释说枪击事件没有正式的刑事指控，因为在枪支和帮派的世界中“沉默意味着生存”。 但检察官表示，被告是“一个很难保持沉默的人”，并指出……

title.en: Iran to go 'full offensive' if diplomacy fails as Trump threatens to bomb Oman
title.zh: 伊朗称若外交失败将“全面进攻”，特朗普威胁轰炸阿曼

summary.en: Iran has stated it will launch a "full offensive" if diplomatic efforts fail, while separately negotiating an agreement with Oman regarding the management of the Strait of Hormuz. The statement comes amidst threats from former President Trump to bomb Oman.
summary.zh: 伊朗表示，如果外交努力失败，它将采取“全面攻势”，同时正与邻国阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡的管理问题进行谈判。此前，前总统特朗普曾威胁要轰炸阿曼。

body.en:
Iran will shift to a "fully offensive" military posture because efforts to negotiate a permanent end to its war with the United States have stalled, as the US ruled out extending a temporary ceasefire agreement.

Progress towards peace talks and a resumption of oil tanker traffic through the strategic Strait of Hormuz has ground to a halt, with no sign that the warring parties are moving towards ending the conflict that the US and Israel launched with attacks on Iran on 28 February.

"Iranian entities must be prepared to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and wider region, as Iran will be ready to make decisions and take action on difficult decisions," a senior Iranian official told Reuters news agency.

The official added that Iran would conduct a "timely and precise" military attack to break the US naval blockade if diplomacy failed.

Monday marked the day Iran and the US were expected to reach a final peace agreement under a memorandum of understanding signed in June aimed at ending the war.

Signed on 17 June, the MoU set a 60-day timeframe for the US and Iran to reach a broader deal on Iran's nuclear program and US sanctions.

The agreement, which declared the "immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts", quickly unravelled over a dispute about control of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway through which a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas flowed before the war.

Asked by reporters on Monday if the US was seeking to extend June's interim agreement, US President Donald Trump said no.

Iran said point 5 of the MoU gave it the right to manage the strait, which it shares with Oman, while the US rejected that interpretation. Hostilities resumed as Iran began firing on vessels it said were trying to sail through Hormuz on an unapproved route, and Trump said on 7 July that the pact was "over".

"Within the short period of a few weeks set by Iran, all the agreement's provisions must be implemented by the US. This is a precondition for further negotiations with the US," the Iranian official told Reuters, adding that mediators would share Iran's deadline with the US and regional countries.

Iran has been negotiating separately with its neighbour across the strait, Oman, to manage Hormuz, seen as a key component of a wider deal, and says it is close to an agreement, although progress has been slow.

Trump threatened to bomb Oman if it "gets in the way" of a US deal with Iran on the Strait of Hormuz and called for Iran to surrender.

title.en: A high-stakes vote on wealth, power and inequality is looming

summary.en: California, home to many billionaires, is preparing for a vote on a proposed wealth tax.

body.en:
In November, California will vote on a proposal to levy a one-off 5 per cent tax on the wealth of all billionaires in the state.

Google co-founder and billionaire Sergey Brin has already spent US$100 million on political donations to a group opposing the tax. Brin is hoping to avoid a potential tax bill of US$13 billion, a return of roughly 130-to-1 if that investment is successful.

Advocates of the billionaire tax claim it would raise US$100 billion in revenue, to be allocated directly to state-funded healthcare, food assistance and public education.

Supporters of the union-backed proposal also highlight that most billionaires currently pay lower marginal rates of tax than the average worker, and that the revenue is desperately needed to fill gaps in funding created by US President Donald Trump’s cuts to Medicaid.

Its critics, which include California’s Democratic Governor Gavin Newsom, argue the measure will drive billionaires and their tax revenue to leave the state.

Similar measures targeting the ultrawealthy are currently under consideration around the world.

In New York, Mayor Zohran Mamdani has proposed a 2 per cent income tax increase for those earning over US$1 million, and passed a property surcharge tax on second homes. Other US states — including Washington state, Maine and Minnesota — have passed or are considering similar income or wealth tax measures.

In the United Kingdom, a group of 120 millionaires have launched a “Proud to Pay” campaign asking the government to levy an additional 2% tax on wealth over £10 million.

Behind the public discussion of California’s billionaire tax lies a much deeper debate about spiralling global inequality.

Recent data from the US shows the share of economic output flowing to workers has dropped to a record low of 52.9 per cent in 2026. This means for every US$100 the economy produces, workers take home US$52.90 in pay, the smallest share since records began in 1947.

Conversely, the wealth of billionaires has accelerated rapidly. As of 2026, Forbes reports a global record 3,428 billionaires.

Perhaps most symptomatically, in June Elon Musk briefly became the world’s first trillionaire after the public launch of SpaceX. His wealth now sits at around US$800 billion.

Some blame globalisation for this explosion of inequality, but there are two other important related factors to consider as well.

The first is the global decline of the trade union movement. With union membership and power declining around the world, the ability of workers to negotiate for better wages has declined.

title.en: UAE economy: On the verge of collapse or on way to recovery?
title.zh: 阿联酋经济：处于崩溃边缘还是正在复苏？

summary.en: On one hand, the UAE economy is suffering due to the Iran war, as residents leave and tourists cancel plans. On the other hand, UAE authorities insist everything is fine and recovery is underway. What's really going on?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On one hand, the UAE economy is suffering due to the Iran war, as residents leave and tourists cancel plans. On the other hand, UAE authorities insist everything is fine and recovery is underway. What's really going on?

In July, authorities in the United Arab Emirates made a headline-grabbing offer: If UAE residents could entice visitors there between July and October this year, the residents would qualify for a package of perks worth around $800. That was despite the fact that most foreign governments are still cautioning their citizens against travel to the UAE due to the Iran war.

After Israel and the US began launching strikes at Iran at the end of February, Iran responded by attacking US allies in the region, including the UAE. As a result, hotel occupancy in the emirate of Dubai plummeted , with rooms going from 80% full to only around 10% occupied.

Since then, some UAE hotels have closed prematurely for planned renovations and other five-star resorts have enticed UAE residents for "staycations" in luxury accommodation with a 50% discount.

Out of around 11.8 million people in the UAE , up to about 10.4 million are non-nationals . These locals run the gamut from millionaires enjoying their tax-free status in the UAE to expats who work on building sites or as cleaners and send their wages to family back home.

Many wealthier individuals with security concerns left when Iranian missiles began flying overhead. To ensure they return after the war, the UAE has said it will take a more flexible approach to rules around tax residency. That is, individuals can be out of the country for longer and not worry about losing their UAE tax status.

The New York Times has reported on the difficult situation that many of the lower-paid foreigners find themselves in as work in hospitality and tourism evaporates. Reporters in Dubai said they had seen individuals going door-to-door looking for work.

The UAE also put together a package worth around $680 million (€587 million) to help affected sectors — this included exempting hotels, restaurants and some private schools from municipality costs or delaying licensing fees.

There have been many more worrying indicators, though. Analysts predict that foreign direct investment in the Gulf states will drop and gross domestic product fall for the first time since the COVID-19 pandemic.

"Although tensions have calmed, the latent risk of a regional conflict reigniting will underpin investor wariness for the remainder of the year," the Economist Intelligence Unit warned in a July 31 briefing .

title.en: Norway wealth fund warns of AI-driven stock market bubble
title.zh: 挪威财富基金警告人工智能驱动的股市泡沫

summary.en: The head of Norway's sovereign wealth fund has warned that soaring AI-driven stock valuations could trigger a sharp correction. This raises questions about the world's largest sovereign wealth fund's exposure to a market downturn.
summary.zh: 挪威主权财富基金负责人警告称，人工智能驱动的股票估值飙升可能引发市场大幅回调。这引发了人们对全球最大主权财富基金在市场下行时面临风险的担忧。

body.en:
The head of Norway's sovereign wealth fund has warned that soaring AI-driven stock valuations could trigger a sharp correction. How exposed is the world's largest sovereign wealth fund to a market downturn?

As if the vast scale of artificial intelligence (AI) investments wasn't scary enough, the head of the world's largest sovereign wealth fund is also sounding the alarm.

Nicolai Tangen, CEO of Norway's Government Pension Fund Global (GPFG), warned last week that, in an extreme market collapse, a massive loss to its $2.4 trillion (€2.07 trillion) portfolio is "not completely improbable."

The fund, created to invest the Nordic country's vast oil and gas revenues, delivered a record profit of 1,753 billion Norwegian kroner ($186 billion/€161 billion) in the first six months of the year.

Yet, Tangen warned that the AI-chip trade — whose lofty valuations helped drive those gains — now poses a serious risk. A sharp correction, he warned, could potentially erase much of the massive wealth built up over the past 30 years.

During what Tangen called an "abnormal" period of low taxes, low inflation and low interest rates, the investments now finance roughly a quarter of the Norwegian government's budget.

While Tangen might sound overly alarmist, Bill Megginson, a leading researcher on sovereign wealth funds, believes many established fund managers share his cautious stance on stock valuations, but are "staying the course, queasily."

"Few managers are inclined to take profits when such a fundamental technology buildout, fueled by literally unprecedented levels of capital spending, shows little evidence of brittleness," Megginson, a finance professor at the University of Oklahoma, told DW.

Major technology companies are expected to invest more than $1 trillion in AI-related infrastructure like chips, data centers  and power infrastructure in the race to match or beat human intelligence.

China , meanwhile, is developing capable AI models at a fraction of the cost of their rivals in the United States .

The Bank for International Settlements warned in June that AI "exuberance" risks ending in a bust if returns fall short of expectations.

Unlike Saudi Arabia or Singapore's sovereign wealth funds, which make large investments in private equity, infrastructure and real estate, Norway largely follows a benchmark-based investment strategy by buying index funds that track major global markets.

title.en: Indonesia neutrality tested by joint naval drill with China
title.zh: 与中国的联合海军演习检验了印尼的中立性

summary.en: Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has raised concerns.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has raised concerns.

On August 12, an Indonesian frigate briefly joined a naval exercise with China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) in waters off Taiwan's east coast, with Taipei asking Jakarta for a reason why it joined the drill.

Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai joined the PLAN guided-missile frigate Honghe for what Jakarta described as a "passing exercise." The maneuvers took place during Taiwan's annual Han Kuang military drill. 

An Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson said they were fully aware that the exercise's location "made it particularly sensitive," but stressed that its vessel's presence "was simply part of its transit route back to Indonesia." According to the Taipei Times , the Indonesian vessel was returning from Vladivostok, Russia after an exercise with the Russian navy.  

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council condemned Beijing's "provocation" after China announced the drill on August 11. Taipei also requested "further details from the Indonesian government" from its Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  

Beijing considers Taiwan to be Chinese territory and has vowed to "reunite" the self-ruled island with the mainland, by using force if necessary . The People's Liberation Army has ratcheted up pressure on Taiwan with frequent military exercises around the island, especially since former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei in 2022.

Amid reactions from Taipei and Washington, the Indonesian Navy stated that its activities with the Chinese Navy were "not warfighting activities in nature" and "not intended as combat training."

Ying-Yu Lin, an associate professor at Taiwan's Tamkang University Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies, told DW that the Chinese exercise with Indonesia had little tactical significance.

"It wasn't as practical as a joint maritime drill, but China wanted to claim its capability in the waters," he said.

However, Ratih Kabinawa, a visiting research fellow at the Japan Institute of International Affairs focusing on Taiwan-Indonesia ties, told DW that regardless of the significance of the drills, Indonesia should have expected some reaction from Taiwan .

"Like it or not, Indonesia is now dragged into this kind of geopolitical gambit," she said.

Kabinawa added that passing exercises were among the lowest-level naval activities yet used by China to justify its intimidation of Taiwan.

"Indonesia must also exercise caution in this regard," she said, adding that Jakarta should "not to be too naive," to assume that its participation in a "regular exercise" with China would not cause concern...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚维持不结盟的外交政策，但雅加达有限地参加了在台湾附近与中国海军举行的低级别海军演习，这引起了人们的担忧。 8月12日，一艘印度尼西亚护卫舰短暂参加了与中国人民解放军海军在台湾东海岸附近海域举行的海军演习，台北向雅加达询问其参加演习的原因。 印度尼西亚海军护卫舰 KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai 与中国海军导弹护卫舰红河号一起进行了雅加达所说的“穿越演习”。此次演习是在台湾一年一度的汉光军演期间进行的。 印度尼西亚外交部发言人表示，他们完全意识到演习地点“使其特别敏感”，但强调其船只的存在“只是其返回印度尼西亚的过境路线的一部分”。据《台北时报》报道，这艘印尼舰艇在与俄罗斯海军演习后正从俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克返回。 中国8月11日宣布演习后，台湾陆委会谴责北京的“挑衅”。台北还要求外交部“提供更多细节”。 北京认为台湾是中国领土，并誓言要让这个自治岛屿与大陆“统一”，必要时会使用武力。特别是自美国前众议院议长南希·佩洛西 2022 年访问台北以来，解放军在台湾频繁进行军事演习，加大了对台湾的压力。 在台北和华盛顿的反应中，印度尼西亚海军表示，其与中国海军的活动“本质上不是战斗活动”，并且“无意进行战斗训练”。 台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇告诉德国之声，中国与印尼的演习没有什么战术意义。 他说：“这不像联合海上演习那么实际，但中国希望宣示其在该海域的能力。” 不过，日本国际问题研究所研究台印尼关系的客座研究员拉蒂·卡比纳瓦(Ratih Kabinawa)告诉德国之声，无论演习的意义如何，印尼都应该预料到台湾会做出一些反应。 “无论你喜欢与否，印度尼西亚现在都被拖入了这种地缘政治游戏，”她说。 卡比纳瓦补充说，通过演习是中国迄今为止用来证明其恐吓台湾的正当理由的最低级别的海军活动之一。 她说：“印度尼西亚在这方面也必须保持谨慎。”她补充说，雅加达“不要太天真”，认为参加与中国的“定期演习”不会引起担忧……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Wildfires: Belgium battles blaze, France's Lecornu jeered
title.zh: 野火肆虐：比利时抗击大火，法国勒科尔尼遭嘲讽

summary.en: Wildfires are raging across Europe, from Belgium to Greece, marking one of the continent's most severe seasons. These blazes are occurring amidst frequent heat waves and drought, which studies attribute to human-induced climate change.
summary.zh: 欧洲从比利时到希腊野火肆虐，这是欧洲有史以来最严重的火灾季节之一。这些大火发生在频繁的热浪和干旱之中，研究表明这些现象是由人为引起的气候变化所驱动的。

body.en:
Fires are raging from Belgium to Greece as Europe suffers one of its most severe wildfire seasons to date. The blazes come amid frequent heat waves and drought that studies say are driven by human-induced climate change.

Fires are burning in several European countries on Monday as the continent experiences a spate of wildfires after many weeks of hot and dry weather .

Some 576,000 hectares (2,225 square miles) of land have been burnt out so far this year, according to data from the European Forest Fire Information System — an area twice the size of Luxembourg.

Europe suffered its worst fire season on record last year, with more than a million hectares of land burned, but that sad record could be beaten in 2026, as the fire season still has some time to run.

The fire, which broke out on Friday, has destroyed some 3,000 hectares (7,500 acres). It is the country's largest in modern history.

King Philippe interrupted his summer vacation to visit the scene and speak with emergency services, calling the park a "national treasure." Philippe spoke of a "difficult moment for Belgium" and was briefed by local, regional and national political leaders on site. 

Germany's Defense Ministry said on Monday that it would be sending two military water-bombing helicopters to the region.

On Sunday evening, some 30 people living in the German town of Monschau were ordered to evacuate as the fire threatened to cross the border, but the danger has since receded.

Weather agency IRM said between 5 and 9 millimeters (0.2 to 0.35 inches) of rain was forecast on Monday in the High Fens.

Fire services on the Greek island of Salamina, near the capital, Athens, have almost succeeded in putting out two fires there, they said on Monday.

The fires have claimed two lives and caused the evacuation by boat of nearly 500 people.

The fire department said the fires spread in just seven minutes amid strong winds, trapping the elderly couple, who died near their home.

The island is popular with day travelers, with the fire breaking out near full beaches.

French Prime Minister Sebastian Lecornu has been jeered by residents in the fire-ravaged village of Le Porge in the western Gironde region.

Altogether 183 homes in the village were destroyed in a giant wildfire last month  that forced the evacuation of more than 220,000 residents and tourists.

title.en: 'An incredible light': Nashville and Heroes star Hayden Panettiere dead at 36
title.zh: “不可思议的光芒”：纳什维尔和英雄明星海顿·潘妮蒂尔去世，享年36岁

summary.en: Hayden Panettiere, known for her roles in "Nashville" and "Heroes," has passed away at the age of 36. The cause of the actor's death has not been disclosed.
summary.zh: 因出演《音乐之乡》和《英雄》而闻名的演员海顿·潘妮蒂尔去世，享年36岁。这位演员的死因尚未公布。

body.en:
Hayden Panettiere, star of popular television series including Heroes and Nashville, has died. She was 36.

Panettiere’s father, Skip, announced the actor’s death in a statement provided to the US network ABC News on Monday.

"It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of our beloved Hayden. She was an incredible light and a force of nature who brought immeasurable love and joy to all who knew her — and to the millions who watched her onscreen," his statement said.

No cause of death was announced, and a publicist for Panettiere did not immediately respond to an email from the Associated Press (AP).

Panettiere, who would have turned 37 this week, began her career as a child actor in commercials and soap operas.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Her role as a cheerleader with superpowers in Heroes propelled her to fame in 2006, with the series revolving around the mantra "Save the cheerleader, save the world."

"I think Heroes is really hot because it’s just a really great combination of everything that people love — they love reality, they love sci-fi and things like X-Men where they get to dream of something bigger," Panettiere told AP in 2008.

"And at the core of it are these human stories that people can relate to, very rugged. And it’s just grabbed everyone in every age group."

She went on to win three Teen Choice Awards for that role and was a Grammy Award nominee for a children’s spoken word album recorded a few years after the release of the animated movie A Bug’s Life.

Panettiere later played a brash country upstart opposite Connie Britton on Nashville, which aired on US network ABC for four seasons before being cancelled and revived on CMT.

She did her own singing in the show, which scored some hits on country charts, spawned US tours and earned Panettiere two supporting actress Golden Globe nominations.

Panettiere had 11 songs recorded for Nashville appear on Billboard’s Hot Country Songs charts during the show’s run, including two featuring Britton.

Panettiere's younger brother, Jansen, who was also an actor, died of a heart condition in 2023, at age 28.

She had been open about her struggles with alcohol addiction and depression, including after the birth of her daughter with Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko in 2014.

In an interview with podcaster Jay Shetty after her memoir came out in May, Panettiere talked about the custody arrangement for her 11-year-old daughter, who lives full-time with Klitschko in Ukraine.

title.en: The US warship Iran is using as a propaganda weapon

summary.en: Reports indicate that US sailors have been jumping off a warship that has set a modern-day record for consecutive days at sea. Iran is reportedly capitalizing on these incidents.

body.en:
Donald Trump may have several problems in the war against Iran — but a ship ain't one.

Or so the United States president insists, after batting away concerns of difficult conditions on board a long-deployed warship playing a major part in the conflict.

There are growing concerns for the crew members aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, which is currently on a record-breaking nine months at sea. The warship was deployed to the Middle East in January and is supporting US military operations by carrying aircraft and assisting the blockade of Iranian ports .

Without a port call in more than 200 days, it has broken modern US Navy records for consecutive days at sea. Dozens of military families have complained of food shortages, plumbing problems and declining mental health among crew members, with some even telling US media of attempts by loved ones to jump overboard.

Though the vessel is now returning to port, Trump has dismissed concerns about lengthy deployments, saying the ship has been at sea "not nearly long enough".

But as the war shows no signs of ending, his administration is facing not just concerns from military families, but domestic calls for investigations and questions over his military strategy.

There are roughly 5,000 sailors and US Marines on board the vessel, according to US politicians.

Two military-focused outlets, Navy Times and Stars and Stripes, reported sailors were jumping overboard due to burnout and low morale. The outlets spoke to the wives of sailors who had either tried to jump or had witnessed and intervened when others tried to.

In a letter to US defence secretary Pete Hegseth, US Democratic senator Richard Blumenthal described reports of supply shortages, water contamination, plumbing issues, deteriorating mental health, deck safety concerns, and disruptions in the mail system.

Blumenthal also raised concern that extended Navy deployments may be becoming normalised as a "feature rather than an exception" in US military strategy.

But the Trump administration has dismissed media reports as misinformation. Hegseth said reports about conditions on the ship "completely misrepresented" the situation and that the government ensured every ship had "everything" that can be provided at "every single moment".

US Central Command (CENTCOM) said no service members aboard the aircraft carrier have died, but acknowledged one sailor who fell overboard on 3 August "was quickly and safely recovered" — without detailing why the incident occurred.

title.en: Indonesia neutrality tested by joint naval drill with China

summary.en: Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has raised concerns.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has raised concerns.

On August 12, an Indonesian frigate briefly joined a naval exercise with China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) in waters off Taiwan's east coast, with Taipei asking Jakarta for a reason why it joined the drill.

Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai joined the PLAN guided-missile frigate Honghe for what Jakarta described as a "passing exercise." The maneuvers took place during Taiwan's annual Han Kuang military drill. 

An Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson said they were fully aware that the exercise's location "made it particularly sensitive," but stressed that its vessel's presence "was simply part of its transit route back to Indonesia." According to the Taipei Times , the Indonesian vessel was returning from Vladivostok, Russia after an exercise with the Russian navy.  

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council condemned Beijing's "provocation" after China announced the drill on August 11. Taipei also requested "further details from the Indonesian government" from its Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  

Beijing considers Taiwan to be Chinese territory and has vowed to "reunite" the self-ruled island with the mainland, by using force if necessary . The People's Liberation Army has ratcheted up pressure on Taiwan with frequent military exercises around the island, especially since former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei in 2022.

Amid reactions from Taipei and Washington, the Indonesian Navy stated that its activities with the Chinese Navy were "not warfighting activities in nature" and "not intended as combat training."

Ying-Yu Lin, an associate professor at Taiwan's Tamkang University Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies, told DW that the Chinese exercise with Indonesia had little tactical significance.

"It wasn't as practical as a joint maritime drill, but China wanted to claim its capability in the waters," he said.

However, Ratih Kabinawa, a visiting research fellow at the Japan Institute of International Affairs focusing on Taiwan-Indonesia ties, told DW that regardless of the significance of the drills, Indonesia should have expected some reaction from Taiwan .

"Like it or not, Indonesia is now dragged into this kind of geopolitical gambit," she said.

Kabinawa added that passing exercises were among the lowest-level naval activities yet used by China to justify its intimidation of Taiwan.

"Indonesia must also exercise caution in this regard," she said, adding that Jakarta should "not to be too naive," to assume that its participation in a "regular exercise" with China would not cause concern...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚维持不结盟的外交政策，但雅加达有限地参加了在台湾附近与中国海军举行的低级别海军演习，这引起了人们的担忧。 8月12日，一艘印度尼西亚护卫舰短暂参加了与中国人民解放军海军在台湾东海岸附近海域举行的海军演习，台北向雅加达询问其参加演习的原因。 印度尼西亚海军护卫舰 KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai 与中国海军导弹护卫舰红河号一起进行了雅加达所说的“穿越演习”。此次演习是在台湾一年一度的汉光军演期间进行的。 印度尼西亚外交部发言人表示，他们完全意识到演习地点“使其特别敏感”，但强调其船只的存在“只是其返回印度尼西亚的过境路线的一部分”。据《台北时报》报道，这艘印尼舰艇在与俄罗斯海军演习后正从俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克返回。 中国8月11日宣布演习后，台湾陆委会谴责北京的“挑衅”。台北还要求外交部“提供更多细节”。 北京认为台湾是中国领土，并誓言要让这个自治岛屿与大陆“统一”，必要时会使用武力。特别是自美国前众议院议长南希·佩洛西 2022 年访问台北以来，解放军在台湾频繁进行军事演习，加大了对台湾的压力。 在台北和华盛顿的反应中，印度尼西亚海军表示，其与中国海军的活动“本质上不是战斗活动”，并且“无意进行战斗训练”。 台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇告诉德国之声，中国与印尼的演习没有什么战术意义。 他说：“这不像联合海上演习那么实际，但中国希望宣示其在该海域的能力。” 不过，日本国际问题研究所研究台印尼关系的客座研究员拉蒂·卡比纳瓦(Ratih Kabinawa)告诉德国之声，无论演习的意义如何，印尼都应该预料到台湾会做出一些反应。 “无论你喜欢与否，印度尼西亚现在都被拖入了这种地缘政治游戏，”她说。 卡比纳瓦补充说，通过演习是中国迄今为止用来证明其恐吓台湾的正当理由的最低级别的海军活动之一。 她说：“印度尼西亚在这方面也必须保持谨慎。”她补充说，雅加达“不要太天真”，认为参加与中国的“定期演习”不会引起担忧……

title.en: Movie that went viral for terrible animation becomes China box office hit
title.zh: 因糟糕的动画而走红的电影成为中国票房热门

summary.en: Niu Lai's confusing plot and laughable animation quality has won ironic fans on the internet.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Niu Lai, a low-budget animation film about a cow in a dream sequence has seen a huge jump in ticket sales after going viral for its confusing plot and terrible graphics.

It grossed just 7,705 yuan ($1,140; £843) in the first 10 days after its release, but has now made more than 11.4 million yuan, according to movie tracking site Mao Yan. That means it is holding ground against Hollywood blockbusters like The Odyssey and Spider Man: Brand New Day.

"You may regret for 80 minutes if you watch it, but if you don't, you'll regret it for life," one popular social media post about the film said.

Other social media users have hailed the movie as the antidote to the AI slop that is taking over social media algorithms.

They are sharing clips praising Niu Lai's "hand-crafted" method - a reference to the poor animation quality - as "proof" that its creators did not use AI.

Another social media user called it "pure handmade" and the biggest "dark horse" of the summer movie season.

Others say they are rooting for the movie because they desperately hope for a "bullish" stock market - a reference to the fact that the words "bull" and "cow" share the same character in Chinese.

"If the index reaches 4,000 tomorrow I will go to the cinema to support this movie," one Weibo user wrote.

"It is a terrible movie but has a great name," another comment linking the movie to stock investments said.

Niu Lai was a low-budget, lowkey production from the outset, and had received almost no publicity before its release earlier this month.

But now it has proved so popular that cinemas have added screenings of the film in response to the soaring demand.

But given that it does not even have a proper promotional poster, cinema staff have resorted to drawing their own posters to entice audiences to watch.

"This record is unprecedented and will likely remain so," a Weibo account dedicated to tracking movies noted.

But not everyone is celebrating its unexpected success. Over the weekend, a commentary by state-owned Beijing News warned that cinemas risk "losing the trust" of viewers if they "continue to lower their standard" with additional screenings of Niu Lai.

Mentioning previous movies that had been mocked for poor quality, Niu Lai has "once again lowered the bar for audiences' expectations of poorly made films", reads a commentary by state-owned Beijing News.

It urged cinemas to "act as gatekeepers for the audience, and clearly reject films that are obviously not up to standard instead of letting films like Niu Lai run rampant".
body.zh: 《牛来》是一部讲述一头牛在梦境中的低成本动画电影，因其令人困惑的情节和糟糕的画面而走红后，票房收入大幅增长。 据电影追踪网站猫眼称，该片上映后 10 天的票房收入仅为 7,705 元人民币（1,140 美元；843 英镑），但目前已超过 1140 万元人民币。这意味着它在与《奥德赛》和《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》等好莱坞大片的竞争中占据一席之地。 “如果你看它，你可能会后悔80分钟，但如果你不看，你会后悔一生，”一篇关于这部电影的热门社交媒体帖子说道。 其他社交媒体用户称赞这部电影是应对正在接管社交媒体算法的人工智能问题的解毒剂。 他们分享的视频赞扬了牛来的“手工制作”方法——指的是糟糕的动画质量——作为其创作者没有使用人工智能的“证据”。 另一位社交媒体用户称其为“纯手工制作”，是暑期电影季最大的“黑马”。 其他人则表示，他们之所以支持这部电影，是因为他们迫切希望股市“牛市”——指的是“牛”和“牛”在中文中同字。 一位微博用户写道：“如果明天指数达到4000，我会去电影院支持这部电影。” 另一位将这部电影与股票投资联系起来的评论说：“这是一部糟糕的电影，但名字却很好。” 《牛来》从一开始就是一部低预算、低调的作品，在本月初上映之前几乎没有受到任何宣传。 但现在事实证明，它非常受欢迎，以至于电影院增加了这部电影的放映次数，以应对不断飙升的需求。 但由于连合适的宣传海报都没有，影院工作人员只好自己画海报来吸引观众观看。 “这个记录是史无前例的，而且很可能会保持下去，”一个专门追踪电影的微博账号指出。 但并非所有人都在庆祝其意外的成功。周末，国有媒体《新京报》的一篇评论警告称，如果电影院“继续降低标准”增加放映《牛来》，就有“失去观众信任”的风险。 国有媒体《新京报》发表评论称，提到之前因质量低劣而被嘲笑的电影，牛来“再次降低了观众对劣质电影的期望”。 它敦促电影院“充当观众的把关人，明确拒绝那些明显不合格的电影，而不是让《牛来》这样的电影泛滥成灾”。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: After Hormuz, China looks to the promise – and peril – of the Arctic’s ‘ice silk road’
title.zh: 继霍尔木兹海峡之后，中国着眼于北极“冰上丝绸之路”的机遇与风险

summary.en: China has initiated the first regular shipping transits through the Arctic's northern sea route, aiming to establish an "ice silk road." This new maritime path, however, raises significant concerns regarding its potential environmental impact and geopolitical implications.
summary.zh: 中国已开通北极航线的首次定期运输，旨在建立一条“冰上丝绸之路”。然而，这条新的海上航线在环境影响和地缘政治方面引发了重大担忧。

body.en: China has established the first scheduled transit through the northern sea route, but questions remain over the environmental and political risks When Marco Rubio suggested that the world should look to new shipping lanes to bypass the logjammed strait of Hormuz, it’s unlikely he had the Arctic’s northern sea route in mind. And yet in recent months the promise of this 5,500km channel – cleaved through frozen seas by nuclear-powered icebreakers and illuminated by a sun that never dips below the Arctic horizon – has grown. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国已经建立了第一条通过北方海路的定期过境航线，但环境和政治风险仍然存在问题。当马可·卢比奥建议世界应该寻求新的航道以绕过堵塞的霍尔木兹海峡时，他不太可能想到北极的北方海路。然而近几个月来，这条 5,500 公里长的航道 — — 由核动力破冰船劈开冰冻的海洋，并由永远不会低于北极地平线的太阳照亮 — — 的前景越来越大。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of new trade routes like the Arctic's "ice silk road" highlights humanity's drive for progress and efficiency. Yet, as the story notes, such ventures also carry significant environmental and political risks that demand careful consideration. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to foresee danger and take precautions, rather than rushing headlong into...
reflection.zh: 像北极“冰上丝绸之路”这样的新贸易路线的开辟，彰显了人类对进步和效率的追求。然而，正如报道所指出的，此类项目也伴随着重大的环境和政治风险，需要我们审慎考量。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们预见危险并采取预防措施，而不是为了短期利益而贸然陷入潜在的危机。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站与大量简历：澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: An Australian firm has been caught up in an FBI investigation into alleged Chinese espionage, involving a fake consultancy website that impersonated the Brisbane company. This fake site was among 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice.
summary.zh: 一家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查，其中涉及一个冒充这家布里斯班公司的虚假咨询网站。这个虚假网站是美国司法部查获的13个网站之一。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被忽略。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights how deception, even when elaborately crafted, often has a limited lifespan. While falsehoods may initially mislead, their true nature is eventually revealed, as seen in the seizure of these fake websites. Yahweh's word reminds us that truth ultimately prevails, and deceit cannot endure indefinitely.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了欺骗，即使精心策划，也往往寿命有限。虚假信息可能一时蒙蔽，但其真实面目终将被揭露，正如这些虚假网站被查获一样。雅伟的话语提醒我们，真理最终会得胜，谎言无法永远持续。

verse.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verse.textZh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。

title.en: How to buy a ‘mega-dinghy’: the perilous new model of Channel crossing
title.zh: 如何购买“巨型橡皮艇”：危险的英吉利海峡偷渡新模式

summary.en: The Guardian China reports on the alarming trend of large dinghies, capable of carrying hundreds, being used for perilous Channel crossings. The article investigates the supply chain for these vessels, noting that large orders are readily fulfilled by manufacturers.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版报道称，载有数百人的大型充气艇被用于危险的英吉利海峡偷渡，这一趋势令人担忧。文章调查了这些大型船只的来源，指出制造商可以轻松满足大批量订单。

body.en: Boats carrying hundreds of people are a clear and alarming trend. But where do such large vessels come from? Providing a large dinghy for use in the choppy seas of western Europe was not a problem, as long as the order was for more than 20 vessels, they said. The sales manager at the Chinese company even had an online brochure for an undercover Guardian reporter, posing as a prospective client, to peruse. They had a production capacity of 500 boats a month and, yes, it was possible to get even bigger ones for the right price. They could do a seven or even an eight-metre military-style dinghy for $1,678 (£1,238) a boat, without the engines, but that would be lacking CE certification, the mandatory mark that shows a product meets EU health and safety requirements. Additional reporting by Lyndon Li Continue reading...
body.zh: 载有数百人的船只是一个明显且令人震惊的趋势。但这么大的船只从哪里来呢？他们表示，只要订单超过 20 艘，提供一艘在西欧波涛汹涌的海域使用的大型小艇就不成问题。这家中国公司的销售经理甚至还为一位冒充潜在客户的卫报卧底记者准备了一份在线手册供其细读。他们的生产能力为每月 500 艘船，是的，有可能以合适的价格获得更大的船。他们可以以每艘 1,678 美元（1,238 英镑）的价格制造一艘七米甚至八米长的军用小艇，不带发动机，但这将缺乏 CE 认证，这是表明产品符合欧盟健康和安全要求的强制性标志。林登·李的补充报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on the supply of vessels for perilous journeys reminds us of the vulnerable individuals seeking safety and new beginnings. Yahweh calls us to recognize His presence in those who are marginalized and in desperate need. Our compassion for 'the least of these' reflects our love for Him.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于用于危险旅程的船只供应的报道，提醒我们那些寻求安全和新生活的弱势个体。雅伟呼召我们要在那些被边缘化和极度需要的人身上认出祂的存在。我们对“这些最小的弟兄”的怜悯，反映了我们对祂的爱。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Fauci hearing was painful to watch. But we need answers on Covid-19’s origin| David Relman
title.zh: 福奇听证会令人痛苦，但我们需要新冠病毒起源的答案 | 大卫·雷尔曼

summary.en: Despite recent congressional hearings, understanding the origin of Covid-19 remains elusive, with a microbiologist observing a deterioration in public discourse surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 尽管近期国会举行了听证会，但了解新冠病毒的起源仍然困难重重，一位微生物学家指出，围绕这一问题的公共讨论正在恶化。

body.en: Despite the recent hearings in Congress, we seem to be even further from the goal of understanding Covid-19’s origin’s than we have ever been As a microbiologist and infectious disease clinician, it has been tough to watch the recent devolution of public discourse on Covid-19 origins. It has been especially difficult for me to read the comments of Anthony Fauci about the origins debate in his now-public diary . And it has been painful to watch the televised spectacle hosted by the US senator Rand Paul on 29 July involving a hostile interrogation of Fauci. Despite many early pleas, including my own , for a dispassionate, objective assessment of what we know, don’t know and need to know about Covid-19 origins, we seem to be even further from this goal now than we have ever been – plagued by politicization, polarization and illogical thinking. David Relman is a professor of medicine and microbiology at Stanford University. He was an inaugural member of the US National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity and president of the Infectious Diseases Society of America Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管最近在国会举行了听证会，但我们似乎距离了解 Covid-19 起源的目标比以往任何时候都更远。作为一名微生物学家和传染病临床医生，很难看到最近公众关于 Covid-19 起源的讨论的转移。对我来说，阅读安东尼·福奇在他现已公开的日记中关于起源争论的评论尤其困难。 7 月 29 日美国参议员兰德·保罗主持的电视节目对福奇进行敌意审讯，令人感到痛苦。尽管包括我自己在内的许多人早期呼吁对我们所知道、不知道和需要了解的 Covid-19 起源进行冷静、客观的评估，但我们现在似乎比以往任何时候都离这个目标更远——受到政治化、两极分化和不合逻辑思维的困扰。大卫·雷尔曼是斯坦福大学医学和微生物学教授。他是美国国家生物安全科学咨询委员会的首任成员和美国传染病学会主席继续阅读...

reflection.en: The struggle to understand complex issues like the origin of Covid-19, especially amidst contentious public discourse, reminds us of the wisdom in seeking thorough examination. Proverbs 18:17 suggests that true understanding emerges only after hearing all sides and carefully scrutinizing every claim. This calls for patience and a commitment to truth beyond...
reflection.zh: 在围绕新冠病毒起源等复杂问题展开的激烈公共讨论中，我们努力寻求理解，这提醒我们彻底审查的重要性。箴言18:17指出，真正的理解只有在听取各方意见并仔细审查每项主张之后才能浮现。这要求我们超越初步印象，以耐心和对真理的承诺，从而走向更清晰的道路。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘TikTok wouldn’t open at all’: Taiwan simulates an internet blackout, with an eye on China threat
title.zh: “抖音完全打不开”：台湾模拟互联网中断，以应对中国威胁

summary.en: Taiwan conducted its first internet blackout simulation, prompted by concerns over the security of its undersea cables, which are vital for its digital connectivity. During the exercise in Taipei, air raid sirens sounded, mobile alerts pinged, and police directed people off the streets.
summary.zh: 台湾周四首次进行互联网中断模拟演习，原因是担心作为其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全。在台北的演习中，防空警报响起，手机警报提示音不断，警察引导人们离开街道。

body.en: Taiwan practised cutting off internet for the first time amid concerns about the safety of the undersea cables that form its ‘digital lifeline’ In Taipei, the streets swiftly empty as air raid sirens ring out and alerts ping on mobile phones. Police officers usher any stragglers into shelters, leaving the capital suddenly deserted. In cities across Taiwan, these kinds of drills are a fact of life every year , amid the growing threat posed by China across the strait, but this time there is something different. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于担心构成其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全性，台湾周四首次练习切断互联网。在台北，随着空袭警报的响起和手机上的警报声，街道迅速空无一人。警察把掉队的人带进避难所，首都突然变得空无一人。在台湾各城市，随着海峡两岸中国构成的威胁日益加剧，此类演习每年都是家常便饭，但这次有所不同。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Taiwan's simulation of an internet blackout highlights the deep anxieties nations face regarding critical infrastructure and potential threats. In moments of such vulnerability and preparation, the ancient promise of Yahweh reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for divine presence offers strength and help. This spiritual anchor can guide communities as...
reflection.zh: 台湾模拟互联网中断，凸显了各国在关键基础设施和潜在威胁面前的深层焦虑。在面对这种脆弱和准备的时刻，雅伟的古老应许提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为神圣的同在提供力量和帮助。这个属灵的锚点可以指引社群应对复杂的挑战并建立韧性。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: The west turns a blind eye to Xi Jinping’s repressive regime in China | Letters
title.zh: 西方国家对习近平在中国的压制性政权视而不见 | 来信

summary.en: Jennifer Hubbard and other letter writers express concern that Western nations are ignoring China's repressive regime, particularly its 'ethnic unity' law used to suppress minorities. They argue that meaningful international diplomacy is urgently needed to address these human rights issues.
summary.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德及其他来信者表示，西方国家对中国压制性政权，特别是其用于压制少数民族的“民族团结”法视而不见。他们认为，急需有意义的国际外交来解决这些人权问题。

body.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard . Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that western governments will continue to pay lip service to notions of human rights in China while pursuing short-term economic goals, ultimately destructive to their own productivity ( President Xi never wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip, 8 August ). This has been the pattern since June 1989, the Tiananmen Square massacre. His faint hope that the young urban Chinese might overturn Xi’s regime is a judgment on the failure of western governments to show any foresight, integrity, effective diplomacy, joined-up thinking or action. They rely on the self-sacrifice of individuals such as Jimmy Lai , Lobga Rangzen and countless – often to us nameless – individuals who put their lives on the line while we wring our hands and weep crocodile tears. Continue reading...
body.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德写道，早就应该在国际层面开展有意义的外交。再加上杰弗里·迪克森和简·伦顿的来信。西蒙·蒂斯达尔在其关于中国镇压少数民族的最新工具“民族团结”法的文章中似乎认为，西方政府将继续对中国的人权观念口头上说好，同时追求短期经济目标，最终损害他们自己的生产力（习主席从来不会浪费一场好的危机。随着伊朗、乌克兰和巴勒斯坦分散了世界的注意力，他加强了控制，8月8日）。这就是1989年6月天安门广场屠杀以来的模式。他对中国城市年轻人可能推翻习近平政权的微弱希望是对西方政府未能表现出任何远见、正直、有效外交、联合思维或行动的判断。他们依赖于黎智英（Jimmy Lai）、洛布加·让赞（Lobga Rangzen）等个人的自我牺牲，以及无数（通常对我们来说无名）个人的自我牺牲，他们冒着生命危险，而我们则绞尽脑汁，流下鳄鱼的眼泪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for international diplomacy to address the suppression of minorities echoes the biblical mandate to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. In a world where powerful voices can overshadow the vulnerable, Yahweh reminds us of our responsibility to advocate for justice and the rights of the destitute. May we seek wisdom and courage to uphold...
reflection.zh: 呼吁国际外交以解决少数民族受压迫的问题，与圣经中为不能为自己说话之人发声的命令不谋而合。在一个强大声音可能掩盖弱势群体的世界里，雅伟提醒我们有责任倡导正义和维护贫困者的权利。愿我们寻求智慧和勇气，维护所有人的尊严，特别是那些声音被压制的人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

These changes that we’re proposing are very substantial changes. And they will make it much easier for people to opt out of this advertising. At the same time, as we make it easier for the regulator to enforce the rules around inducements. I understand people’s concern about inducements. And the minister and the government does as well. I think primarily there’s an important role for the regulator to crack down on and enforce these inducements. There’s absolutely no doubt that the implementation of the reforms has made everything worse for older Australians … the government’s got a lot to do to fix the implementation of these once-in-a-generation reforms that should have and could have and still can be what they were intended to be, but they just aren’t being rolled out like that. If the automation that we’re seeing in aged care is transferred over into the NDIS, yes I have very serious concerns about that. We saw 250,000 older Australians reassessed under aged care. Are we talking over 750,000 Australians who live with disability who possibly need to be reassessed? body.en:
Sydney Swans coach Dean Cox says he's "extremely disappointed" after several players were linked to a police investigation into an alleged sexual assault.

Victoria Police attended the Pullman Hotel in East Melbourne on Monday to investigate a sexual assault report in the early hours of the morning.

The Sydney Swans were staying at the hotel, having defeated Essendon at the nearby Melbourne Cricket Ground on Sunday night.

The win meant they locked in second place on the AFL ladder, guaranteeing they would play two home finals, with only an inconsequential game against 13th-placed North Melbourne remaining to complete their home-and-away season.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

On Monday morning, several media outlets reported that several players had been linked to an investigation into an alleged sexual assault.

Several media outlets later reported the names of four of the five players who had reportedly spoken to police to assist their inquiries. The players were not arrested, and no charges have been laid.

SBS News has chosen not to name the players as it has not independently verified their identities.

Victoria Police issued a brief statement, confirming it was investigating a sexual assault report and the "exact circumstances are yet to be established and the investigation into the incident remains ongoing".

It provided a similarly worded updated statement on Tuesday morning, which added: "Police spoke to a number of people at the hotel; however, no one has been arrested or formally interviewed at this time."

On Tuesday morning, coach Dean Cox briefly spoke to reporters outside of the Swans' Sydney headquarters for the first time since the news broke.

"Obviously extremely disappointed with what's happened, and understand the questions and we'll update as we gather more information," Cox said.

Asked if player sanctions could be expected, Cox said: "We're working our way through everything with the AFL and the relevant parties and we'll update when we get more information."

He was also asked whether he had spoken to the players involved, saying: "We'll speak as the day unfolds."

Co-captain Callum Mills also spoke briefly to waiting media at Moore Park on Tuesday morning as he and other players started to filter into the club.

"I can't really comment. There's an investigation ongoing and we don't have the facts yet," Mills said.

The group of players reportedly drove back to Sydney from Melbourne on Monday night.

On Monday, the Swans first confirmed that several players were involved in an "alleged incident".

summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Women living with endometriosis, ovarian cysts and hormone-related conditions are experiencing significantly higher rates of anxiety, depression and self-harm, highlighting the need for mental health support to be integrated into women’s physical healthcare.

Research published by Women's Mental Health Australia on Tuesday found almost half of women with endometriosis reported experiencing anxiety.

Women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome experienced depression and anxiety at up to twice the rate of women without the condition.

The findings have uncovered major gaps in Australia's healthcare system, according to chief operating officer Katrina Locandro.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The government's investing a lot in women's health at the moment ... and there is a really practical step that they could be taking to reduce that gap."

The findings indicate that physical health conditions are associated with poorer mental health.

But the greatest psychological toll is on women living with female-specific physical health conditions, including polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome, a broad condition involving a hormone imbalance, irregular periods and ovarian cysts.

Women with that syndrome reported high rates of depression and anxiety, between 1.6 and 2.2 times higher than women who did not have the condition.

The disparity also extended to suicide and self-harm rates, reported by 10 per cent of women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome and 13 per cent of women with endometriosis, compared with four per cent of women without those conditions.

The research found that one in three women are not seeking help for their mental health issues, often because of financial and stigma-related reasons.

Locandro says every woman attending a government-funded endometriosis and pelvic pain clinic should receive an integrated mental health assessment and support as a standard offering.

"We're not asking the government to build a new system, we're asking it to strengthen an existing one by recognising that women's physical and mental health are inseparable," she said.

Report co-author Bronwyn Graham said that embedding integrated mental health assessment and support into existing services would be a game-changer.

"Women are being asked to manage two separate journeys, one for their body and one for their mind, and to find their own way between them at the point they are least able to."

title.en: The costly contradiction hiding in Australian kitchens
title.zh: 澳大利亚厨房中隐藏的代价高昂的矛盾

summary.en: As the cost of living bites, Australians are trying to make food last longer. But could they be needlessly wasting it as well?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As Australians look for ways to cut grocery costs, confusing food date labels could be driving people to throw out food that's still perfectly safe to eat.

New survey data from financial comparison site Finder suggests 14 per cent of Australians say they've resorted to eating expired food to save money, while 68 per cent of the 1,010 survey participants said they've taken money-saving measures to afford food.

At the same time, confusion over what "use-by" and "best-before" dates actually mean could be costing households at the other end.

OzHarvest has been campaigning for reforms to Australia's date label system, arguing that "evidence has moved on" since it was established more than two decades ago.

The food rescue organisation says date labelling is a major driver of unnecessary food waste.

Research commissioned by the group found food reaching its best-before or use-by date was the most commonly cited reason for disposal, reported by 58 per cent of high-wasting households and 44 per cent of low-waste households.

"Consumers are really confused by the difference between best-before and use-by," said RMIT associate professor Lukas Parker, who has authored research on the topic with End Food Waste Australia.

"We know it's around 50 per cent or more of people just don't know the difference," he told SBS News.

A 2021 government-backed national study estimated Australian households throw away up to $2,500 worth of food each year, with 7.6 million tonnes of food wasted annually — around 300kg per person.

The term "use-by" means the food carrying the label can only be guaranteed safe to consume until that date. Highly perishable products like fresh meat might carry this label.

A "best-before" date, on the other hand, means the product is still safe to consume after that date, but it might no longer be at its best. Products like cereals and pasta might come with a "best-before" label.

According to Food Standards Australia New Zealand, you can still eat foods for a while after the best-before date. They may have lost some quality, but they can still be sold and consumed after the best-before date has passed.

Foods cannot legally be sold after the use-by date, the food standards regulator says.

But many consumers treat both dates the same, according to OzHarvest, meaning food that's safe to eat ends up in the bin.

OzHarvest says people should trust their instincts and senses when deciding whether food past its date needs to go in the bin or is still safe to eat.

"Sniff a product, look at a product, taste it to see if it is okay," its national policy and advocacy lead Katinka Day says.

title.en: Government unveils last-minute gambling reforms ahead of critical new report
title.zh: 政府在重要的新报告发布之前公布最后一刻的赌博改革

summary.en: The government implemented a raft of changes to its gambling reforms shortly before the release of a damning new report.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Sweeping last-minute changes to Labor's gambling reforms, including a crackdown on inducements, have been unveiled in parliament, hours before the release of a damning report on the matter.

A Senate committee report on the proposed changes was tabled on Monday night, slamming the government's attempt to protect vulnerable people from gambling addictions as being too little, too late.

It contained criticism from the coalition, Greens and independent senator David Pocock.

The reforms were referred to the committee for an inquiry over concerns they did not adequately break the connection between betting and sport nor protect kids from gambling exposure.

"This package is not an evidence-led public health response to a public health issue," Pocock said in the report.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It leaves gambling advertising embedded in sport and across Australian media, shifts responsibility onto parents and preserves major parts of the system that have made Australians the biggest gambling losers in the world on a per capita basis."

The changes respond to concerns from the Greens, who said they would not support the bill in its earlier form.

"Inducements are a toxic practice that prey on those who can least afford to gamble and must be outlawed," Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young said.

"Gambling companies must not be allowed to continue to make massive profits off vulnerable people."

The government also pledged a new opt-out register for gambling ads, which would allow Australians to sign up for a one-stop shop for removing the ads from online platforms.

It would function similarly to the Do Not Call register for spam calls, following concerns raised that people would struggle to stay on top of individual opt-out options on each online service.

A levy would be imposed on gambling companies to cover the cost of the register, Communications Minister Anika Wells told parliament.

But critics of the government's work, including the coalition, have said the drawn-out changes were far too delayed.

A report by late Labor MP Peta Murphy into the matter was published in 2023 and contained more than 30 recommendations to limit the power of Australia's gambling industry.

Feedback in the committee report noted many of the recommendations had not been included in the reforms.

"Even the government's response to this (Murphy's) report, tabled on May 12, 2026 — the day of the federal budget when many journalists were in the budget lock-up — became a cynical exercise in media management," the coalition said in its response.

title.en: When should you be able to access your super? Battle lines are being drawn
title.zh: 您什么时候可以提取您的退休金？战线正在划定

summary.en: A political stoush has erupted over superannuation, with Treasurer Jim Chalmers warning others' ideas could decimate the economy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Political battle lines are being drawn over superannuation, with Labor vowing to defend the retirement savings system as the Liberal Party and One Nation attack it as a failure.

On Monday, Treasurer Jim Chalmers signalled super could become a political issue at the next federal election.

"The stakes are high at the next election for a whole range of reasons, and one of them now is the future of Australia's world-leading compulsory superannuation system," Chalmers told reporters as he arrived at Parliament House.

"The Liberals, the Nationals, and One Nation would end compulsory superannuation as we know it. Their policy and their ideology on super would absolutely decimate the economic security and retirement incomes of millions of Australian workers.

"They share a dangerous and divisive anti-worker, anti-super ideology, and if this plays out after the next election, Australian workers will be much worse off."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However a senior Liberal senator later sought to dispute that was the party's ambition.

The stoush began last week when Liberal senator Andrew Bragg declared superannuation an "illiberal experiment".

"It’s one of the biggest public policy failures since federation, in the sense that it hasn’t helped the budget, and it has not really helped many people get off the pension," he told ABC radio on Thursday.

"What it has done is it has created a huge viper's nest for banks and financiers and unions to pilfer, which is why what you saw at the Labor Party conference was now you're going to have super for under 18s."

The Association of Superannuation Funds Australia (ASFA) refuted Bragg's comments, pointing out Australia's age pension expenditure had decreased since the scheme was introduced in 1992.

"Super has meant that even as our population ages, the government's Age Pension bill is going down instead of up. OECD projections have Australia at the lowest public pension spending in the OECD by the mid-2030s," ASFA CEO Mary Delahunty said.

"Super has also meant that reliance on the Age Pension has fallen, with 12 per cent fewer over-65s receiving a part or full Age Pension today than in 2012. This will keep falling as we see the effects of higher super guarantees coming in.

Under the current system, all Australian employers are required to pay a minimum 12 per cent of an employee's salary into a nominated super fund, which cannot be accessed until a person is 60.

title.zh: 悉尼天鹅队球员涉嫌涉嫌事件正在接受警方调查

summary.en: Police attended an East Melbourne hotel following an incident in the early hours of Monday morning.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Several Sydney Swans players are being investigated over an alleged sexual assault in Melbourne.

Victoria Police on Monday said they were investigating a report of sexual assault, as Sydney confirmed several Swans players were involved in an "alleged incident".

Police attended the Pullman Hotel in East Melbourne on Monday after an incident in the early hours of that morning.

The Swans stayed at the hotel on Sunday night after their 36-point win over Essendon at the MCG that locked in second place on the ladder and a home qualifying final.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

On Monday afternoon, Swans chief executive Matthew Pavlich addressed the media in Sydney and again confirmed players had been involved in an "alleged incident", but didn't offer further details.

"We can confirm that several players were involved in an alleged incident last night in Melbourne," Pavlich said.

"We've identified this to the AFL that we are working with them and also the relevant authorities on this matter.

"We're still piecing together exactly what's transpired here and have our own set of internal inquiries ongoing.

"But safe to say that we're extremely shocked and disappointed that this has taken place and that the players have found themselves in this situation.

"We understand the level of interest in the matter, and there'd be lots of speculation, but given it's a police matter right now, that is all that we can say."

"As I said, it's a police matter ongoing. I'm not going to comment any further on it right now," Pavlich said.

Police had earlier confirmed they were investigating a report of sexual assault.

"Police are investigating a report of a sexual assault in East Melbourne on 17 August," Victoria Police said in a statement provided to the Australian Associated Press.

"The incident occurred at a hotel on Wellington Parade in the early hours of the morning.

"The exact circumstances are yet to be established, and the investigation into the incident remains ongoing."

If you or someone you know is impacted by sexual assault, call 1800RESPECT on 1800 737 732, text 0458 737 732, or visit 1800RESPECT.org.au . In an emergency, call 000.
